description_en: Modifies the administrator password of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) device. This operation applies to SAG instances whose device type is SCG5000 or SCG5000-5G and whose device version is 3.4.2 or later
description_zh: 修改SAG设备管理员密码，适用于设备类型为SCG5000或SCG5000-5G的智能接入网关实例，且设备版本为3.4.2及以上
name: UpdateSmartAccessGatewayAdminPassword

parameters.help_en: The Smart Access Gateway instance ID
parameters.name: sag_ins_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: sag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The new logon password for the Smart Access Gateway device.

Password format requirements: The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

Asterisks (*) are used in the sample value to mask the actual password. This does not mean that asterisks are supported in passwords. Specify the password based on the format requirements
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关设备新的登录密码。

密码格式要求：长度为8~30个字符，可包含大小写字母、数字和下划线（_）。

示例值中使用星号（*）以掩盖真实密码，不表示密码支持使用星号，输入密码时请以密码格式要求为准
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only Smart Access Gateway instances that belong to other Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

false (default): no.

true: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询跨账号所属的智能接入网关实例。取值：

false（默认值）：否。

true：是
parameters.name: cross_account

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the Smart Access Gateway instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: resource_uid

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates that the query task is successful
Code.description_zh: 响应码。200标识查询任务成功

Message.description_en: The response message. A value of Successful indicates that the query task is successful
Message.description_zh: 响应消息。Successful标识查询任务成功

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the modification is successful. Valid values:

true: yes.

false: no
Success.description_zh:
修改是否成功。取值：

true：是。

false：否
